name: System line terminator For terminating the EP203’s extinguishant release output to a gas release solenoid
subtitle: Max. 2 line terminators per system
legacyName: System line terminator For terminating the EP203’s extinguishant release output to a gas release solenoid (max. 2 line terminators per system)
summary: An optional system expansion device for use with the EP203/CON three zone automatic extinguisher panel.
description: Ideal for terminating the EP203/CON’s release output to a gas release solenoid or multiple metrons/igniting actuators.
One EP214 terminator is required per solenoid.
Measures just 55m W x 55mm H x 22mm D.

Notes: For solenoids, the EP203’s extinguishant output can supply 1A for a max. duration of 5 minutes; For metrons, The EP203’s extinguishant output is capable of supplying 3A for 50 millseconds. See instructions for more detailed notes.

specs.label: Indicators
specs.value: Active LED (illuminates red when the EP203's extinguishant output is active).

specs.label: Connections
specs.value: Solenoid/Metron (+Ve & -Ve); Panel (+Ve & -Ve); Next line term. (+Ve & -Ve). Max. cable size 1.5mm.
